release_read.basis: Q4 revenue guide $730-750m (midpoint $740m) is about 13% above the ~$656m bar the hunt named, with non-GAAP GM guided flat at ~72% (the feared step-down below 72% did not come) and Q4 EPS guide $1.62-1.66; Q3 beat too ($584.9m vs ~$551m, non-GAAP EPS $1.32 vs ~$1.19). A guide this far above the bar into a 38% run-down justifies roughly the implied move up, discounted for a name that sold its last three beats.

release.released_at_note: Exhibit 99.1 to the 8-K dated 2026-11-03, after the close (call 13:30 PT); exact wire time not read
release.headline: Astera Labs reports Q3 2026 results: record revenue $584.9m, up 49% QoQ and 154% YoY

vs_bar.note: Nasdaq's $0.83 forecast (brief fallback) is not the non-GAAP bar; GAAP EPS was $0.99

vs_bar.consensus_source: company Q3 guide of ~72% (hunt file, Q2 8-K)

key_line.detail: $730-750m against a ~$656m Q4 consensus (single source, TIKR): midpoint about +12.8%; Q4 non-GAAP GM ~72%, non-GAAP EPS $1.62-1.66.

guidance.detail: Q4 revenue $730-750m vs ~$656m street; GM held at ~72% rather than stepping down.

call.detail: Call held last night at 13:30 PT; no transcript or call coverage read in the time available, so what moved on it is unknown. The pre-market weakness against a clear beat-and-raise suggests something on the call or in the mix (GM, customer concentration, 2027 commentary) was taken badly, but this is inference, not a source.

public_reaction.summary: One search for post-print coverage returned only pre-print and August-era articles; no analyst actions from this morning were found in the time available.

tape_read.note: Robust reference 218.80 (-6.34% vs 233.62 prev close); last print 222.07 at 09:14, 233 prints, 27 in the last 30 minutes, not stale. After-hours was -3.6%; pre-market ranged 214.01-243.97, so it traded up into positive territory and then sagged. Market is up (SPY +1.21%, QQQ +0.44%). Against a +11% release read and an 11.55% implied move, the pre-market sits ~17 points below what the release supports: either the market priced something on the call I did not see, or the beats-sold pattern is repeating. Position is -6.8% vs the 238.24 entry.

thesis_check.note: The thesis was that Amazon/Celestica demand would carry a Q4 guide at or above ~$656m and that GM would be the flashpoint. The guide came in ~13% above and GM held at ~72%. The release confirms the thesis; the price so far does not.

expected.open_lag_note: An active pre-market (27 prints in 30 minutes, last at 09:14) means the open should hold most of the -6% gap. A gap against a clean beat-and-raise, with the broad market up 1%, gives a modest lean toward a partial fade back up by 10:00, but the pre-market's slide from +4% to -6% says sellers are in control, so the lean is small.

recommendation.reason: De cijfers en vooral de vooruitzichten voor Q4 zijn duidelijk beter dan verwacht, maar het aandeel staat voorbeurs ruim 6% lager en de positie verliest. Een koersgat dat tegen zulke cijfers in gaat, en dat in een stijgende markt, loopt na de opening vaak deels terug; daarom niet verkopen in de opening maar om 10:00.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Zakt de koers voor 09:30 verder weg richting het voorbeurslaagste punt (rond 214) of verschijnen er koersdoelverlagingen of negatief nieuws over het gesprek met analisten, dan gewoon verkopen bij de opening.
